instruction:
You are a senior mechanical engineer specializing in pump systems.

## Problem

Apply the pump affinity laws to estimate the same pump's performance at a new rotational speed.

## Given

| Parameter | Value | Unit |
|-----------|-------|------|
| Original speed N1 | {{ original_speed_rpm }} | rpm |
| New speed N2 | {{ new_speed_rpm }} | rpm |
| Original flow Q1 | {{ original_flow_l_s }} | L/s |
| Original head H1 | {{ original_head_m }} | m |
| Original power P1 | {{ original_power_kw }} | kW |

{% if archetype_description is defined %}
### Operating Context

{{ archetype_description }}
{% endif %}

{% if tool_available %}
## Available Tool

A pump affinity law calculation tool is available at `/workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py`. Run it with:

```bash
python3 /workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py --help
```

You may use this tool to verify your calculations or compute values directly.
{% endif %}

## Required

Calculate the following:

1. Speed ratio N2/N1
2. New flow rate Q2 (L/s)
3. New total head H2 (m)
4. New pump power P2 (kW)

## Constraints

- No internet access is available. Work from engineering knowledge and the provided tool.
- Assume the same pump geometry, the same fluid, dynamically similar operation, and no cavitation limitation.
- Use Q2 = Q1 x (N2/N1).
- Use H2 = H1 x (N2/N1)^2.
- Use P2 = P1 x (N2/N1)^3.

## Output Format

Show your step-by-step working in Markdown. At the end of your solution, include a JSON block with your final answers in exactly this format:

```json
{
  "speed_ratio": <numeric_value>,
  "new_flow_l_s": <numeric_value>,
  "new_head_m": <numeric_value>,
  "new_power_kw": <numeric_value>
}
```

Write your complete solution to `/workspace/output.md`.
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "pump-affinity-laws"
description = "Pump affinity law calculation for estimating performance at a new speed"
long_description = "Calculates the new flow rate, head, and power draw for the same pump operating at a different rotational speed. The template applies the standard pump affinity laws Q2 = Q1(N2/N1), H2 = H1(N2/N1)^2, and P2 = P1(N2/N1)^3 for deterministic variable-speed pump checks."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "pump-sizing"
standards = ["ANSI/HI Standards"]
tags = ["mechanical", "pump-sizing", "affinity-laws", "variable-speed", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.original_speed_rpm]
type = "float"
unit = "rpm"
description = "Original pump rotational speed N1"
min = 500.0
max = 3600.0

[params.new_speed_rpm]
type = "float"
unit = "rpm"
description = "New pump rotational speed N2"
min = 500.0
max = 3600.0

[params.original_flow_l_s]
type = "float"
unit = "L/s"
description = "Original pump flow rate Q1"
min = 1.0
max = 500.0

[params.original_head_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "Original pump total head H1"
min = 2.0
max = 150.0

[params.original_power_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "Original pump power P1"
min = 0.5
max = 1000.0

[outputs.speed_ratio]
description = "Speed ratio N2/N1"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.new_flow_l_s]
description = "New flow rate Q2"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.new_head_m]
description = "New total head H2"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.new_power_kw]
description = "New pump power P2"
tolerance = 0.03

new_speed_rpm = {min = 900.0, max = 1400.0}
